column2: Are you planning a desktop app? Particularly, with VST3 fx support?

Since you say you don't want to support it, any chance of an open source dump so others can do that?

This seems like a great starting point for someone else to take the reigns.

Thanks for your work regardless, I might end up using it. I agree this is a hole that begs to be filled. Hopefully not by another company peddling beatpacks.
